(Su-Han starts using all of kung fu moves to make Cat Noir fall and roll over to a chimney. He then jumps on Cat Noir.)
Cat Noir: (weakly) Master Fu was much nicer
Su-Han: And his Mira-Kung Fu was much worse. (grabs Cat Noir's hand, and reaches for the ring)

scene: Parisian rooftops. Su-Han follows Ladybug to Cat Noir
conversation:
Su-Han: What?
Cat Noir: Bye-bye! (kicks him into a wall)
Su-Han: If you challenge the clouds, you will face the (thunder)!

scene: Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir discuss what to do with the Miracle Box.
conversation:
Shadow Moth: Furious Fu, bring me that box! (Furious Fu jumps down and runs after it, Ladybug and Cat Noir treat the box as a soccer ball, kicking it around on the field and playing keep away)
Cat Noir: (in an effort to keep the box far from Su-Han and Furious Fu, he kicks it into the goalpost)
Gooaal!!: (Everyone else still chasing after it) Hey! (starts running again)

scene: Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir talk about a plan just off the field.
conversation:
Shadow Moth: (annoyed) No! Not his bell! His ring!
Cat Noir: I am not a wingless bat! (about to start fighting again)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, wait. We'll never defeat him
Cat Noir: What?
Ladybug: We just need (him) not to defeat (us) either
Cat Noir: You lost me
Ladybug: I have to make a call, cover me! ((opens her Bug-Phone))
Cat Noir: That I can do

scene: Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir talk about a plan just off the field.
conversation:
Cat Noir: (stops Furious Fu by jumping on him from behind) We're not done yet!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Ladybug: (reacting to Cat Noir) No!

scene: Rooftops of Paris.
conversation:
Ladybug: Uh, wait, what? No! (He leans in for a kiss, but Ladybug dodges it and gets away, enraged.) Okay, which part of the word (no), did you not (understand?!? (She sucker punches him to the ground.) Gross! You're not Adrien, he would never be so pushy
Cat Noir: (just arriving) That's Félix! Adrien's cousin. I just ran into the real Adrien and he told me everything. You made a lot of enemies in one day, bet you don't have a lot of friends, acting the way you do. Am I wrong? (crosses his arms and smiles. Félix looks down sadly.)
Ladybug: (sees the Trio incoming) Cut it out! There's no time for bickering, they're coming! Lucky Charm! (An aerosol can appears, and she sprays it a bit.)

scene: Rooftops of Paris.
conversation:
Félix: You've got yourself a deal. Now I think it's high time Ladybug and Cat Noir were punished. (He holds out the tablet to Lady Wifi.)
Cat Noir: I hope you've learned your lesson. (Félix nods fearfully, and Ladybug pulls him back up.)
Ladybug and Cat Noir: (as they fist bump) Pound it!

scene: Outside Agreste mansion. Félix is dodging attacks of Collector. When Félix is about to be hit, Ladybug throws her Yo-yo and drags Félix out of the tablet's path.
conversation:
Cat Noir: (pulling Félix) I will get him out of here
Cat Noir: What do you got that Collector wants it so badly?
Félix: My ring
Cat Noir: If it's yours, why would he want to take it from you?
Félix: (fegins innocence) I don't know. My uncle is a strange man
Cat Noir: (seeing the statue being absorbed) Whoa! I hope that statue takes up a lot of memory

scene: Outside Agreste mansion. Félix is dodging attacks of Collector. When Félix is about to be hit, Ladybug throws her Yo-yo and drags Félix out of the tablet's path.
conversation:
Ladybug: Cat Noir! Time for a rebound
Cat Noir: (catching back his staff) Dinner's ready!
Collector: (Nooooo!)

scene: Parisian rooftops near Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir meet up.
conversation:
Gamer 2.0: (on pyra-pod screen) So, Ladybug and Cat Noir? Ready to play? Please enter your pyra-pod
Cat Noir: What if it's a trap, M'lady?
Ladybug: No, I'm sure it's not. He just wants to play. So, let's keep in touch. (puts device into her ear)
Cat Noir: (puts device into his ear)

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Gamer 2.0: (charges towards The Mime) I'm gonna slice you into sashi(mime!)
Cat Noir: Wouldn't you be better off miming a Cat Noir to come lend you a helping paw, M'lady?
Ladybug: I know what I'm doing! (The Mime's shield disappears)
Cat Noir: Be careful! The Mime's object disappears if you talk
Ladybug: Thank you, Captain Obvious!

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Game Voice: Ring out! Mime wins!
Cat Noir: Talking on purpose? Miming your own yo-yo? Clever as ever, M'lady
Ladybug: I won, Gamer 2.0. Release us!

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Ladybug: (groans)
Cat Noir: My turn! My turn! Frightningale, Stormy Weather — Awesome! But a little too awesome for a first battle. Oh, my copycat! Nah, I'd be too good as myself. That'd be too easy
Ladybug: (on earpiece) Hurry up! Choose Copycat and Cataclysm this game away so we can get back home!
Cat Noir: Fine. If we need to hurry this up. (selects Mr. Pigeon)
Ladybug: You've (got) to be kidding me!
Cat Noir: What? I've always wanted to train pigeons

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Gamer 2.0: More like Mega Flop Phoenix. (laugh) It's gonna be the fastest victory ever! (Mr. Pigeon's pigeon charges towards Dark Cupid at fiery speed and attacks him) Ah! Get away, you flying rat!
Cat Noir: (while Mr. Pigeon grabs onto Dark Cupid and throws him on the arena floor) Double ankle grab and smash! Somersault bum drop! (Mr. Pigeon jumps on top of Dark Cupid) Feathered face wash! (Mr. Pigeon's pigeon slaps Dark Cupid's face while Mr. Pigeon grabs Dark Cupid's pin and throws it across the arena) Volatile's Elbow! (breaks pin)
Game Voice: Mr. Pigeon wins!
Cat Noir: Pound it, Fiery Phoenix

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Ladybug: Ugh! C'mon now!
Cat Noir: (while Reflekta approaches Rogercop) They see me catwalking. They hatin'. (pushes Rogercop off the arena)
Game Voice: Reflekta wins!

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Game Voice: Puppeteer wins!
Cat Noir: Ouch... that sure was fast
Gamer 2.0: (laugh) You're the one who wanted to speed things up, and now you're going to lose even faster than you thought, Ladybug

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Gamer 2.0: Cyclone! (Stormy Weather pushes Anansi with a strong breeze) Haha haha hahaha! (looks down the arena for Anansi)
Cat Noir: Surprise! (Anansi shoots a web at Stormy Weather and knocks her off the arena)
Game Voice: Anansi wins!
Cat Noir: Ha ha! See, M'lady? M'lady? You okay?

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Ladybug: This is what you call Knight-fall!
Cat Noir: Ah, she's so pawesome!
Ladybug: I— (Gigantitan defeats Sandboy)
Cat Noir: love— (Desperada defeats Pixelator)
Ladybug: this— (Princess Fragrance defeats Prime Queen)
Cat Noir: game! (Despair Bear defeats Santa Claws)

scene: Gamer 2.0's video game dimension in the Stade des Princes. Ladybug and Cat Noir enter.
conversation:
Gamer 2.0: (I am) the final boss, but how are we going to figure out who should battle me?
Cat Noir: What do you mean?
Gamer 2.0: Well, I'm sure you'd agree that two against one would be very unfair, so the only way to know which one of you will take me on, is if you two fight... (each other!) (Ladybug and Cat Noir gasp)

scene: Parisian rooftops near Stade des Princes.
conversation:
Ladybug: Hey, Cat Noir, between being a superhero and everything else in your life, how do you manage to still have fun? Aren't you scared you'll eventually have to sacrifice everything you love for all of this?
Cat Noir: The times when I have the most fun, my (favorite) moments, are when I'm with (you,) M'lady. And I would give up (everything) for just that. (takes off)
Marinette: Mom? Dad? I know I don't have time to play with you guys these days... but, Max does! And he has a video game he designed which he needs to test! With tons of bugs in it!

scene: The Place des Vosges. Marinette and Adrien are eating a snack.
conversation:
Gamer: Game over!
Cat Noir: Not yet! Here comes a new challenger!
Marinette: Cat Noir! Hey! Over here!
Cat Noir: I heard Miss Video Game Champion really taked! off the final boss
Marinette: Well it doesn't give him extra points to go transforming everyone. Hey, wait, Cat Noir! I left my friend Adrien at the park! He could be in danger, we have to go back!
Cat Noir: Uh... don't worry. Adrien's not in danger. He'll be fine. You'll be safe here. Just stay put. Don't worry, Cat Noir will take care of everything. Arch, leap, and do a barrel roll!
Marinette: Uh, he's always so over-the-top

scene: The streets. Cat Noir follows the Gamer's robot, and sees he is heading for a bus. Cat Noir goes to where the bus is.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Get away from here! As far as you can! (sees the robot) Hurry!
Cat Noir: Hey, tin can! Over here!
Gamer: My calculations indicate that your system's about to crash!

scene: The streets. Cat Noir follows the Gamer's robot, and sees he is heading for a bus. Cat Noir goes to where the bus is.
conversation:
Cat Noir: See? You and me! It was meant to be
Cat Noir: Uh, I think our problem just got a whole lot bigger
Gamer: Level 3. Hahahahahaha!

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Ladybug: Attack the robot with your Cataclysm Power! It might be enough to shock him!
Cat Noir: My pleasure. Two can play this game. Cataclysm! (uses his Cataclysm to destroy the Gamer's robot)
Gamer: Nooooo!

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Cat Noir Style! Booyah!
Cat Noir: Whoa ha ha! Check out that loot!
Ladybug: System crash, Gamer!

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Cat Noir: (his Miraculous beeps) Okay, but I only got a few minutes left
Cat Noir: I'll man it, you shoot!
Ladybug: Why do you get to man it?
Cat Noir: What do you say we flip for it?

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Cat Noir: What do you say we flip for it?
Cat Noir: Okay, you man it and I'll fire
Ladybug: Look out! Here it comes again

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Ladybug: Forcefield, Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Got it. Forcefield activated! (activates the robot's forcefield, destroys the missiles) Cat Saber! (takes the robot's tail off and uses it as a saber.)
Gamer: Gamer-Drill! (activates a drill on the robot's arm, and charges on Ladybug and Cat Noir's robot. The two are still charging.)
Cat Noir: This Gamer's way powerful. He just took out our forcefield!

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Ladybug: Lady Helix! (the robot's two shields fly over to the Gamer's robot, but his robot blocks them.)
Cat Noir: Punch! (the robot's two arms fly over to the Gamer's robot, but his robot neutralizes them) Ear Thunder! (uses the robot's two cat ears to make thunder, but the Gamer's robot blocks it with its own thunder.)
Ladybug: He's anticipating all of our attacks!
Cat Noir: Watch out, Ladybug! (the Gamer's robot charges at them, the two robots fight.)

scene: The Stade des Princes Stadium. Ladybug and Cat Noir appear to fight the Gamer.
conversation:
Ladybug: Shoryubug! (does a Shoryuken at the Gamer's robot)
Cat Noir: Catouken! (fires a blast of energy at the robot, knocking it)
Ladybug: We've gotta get inside his cockpit!
Cat Noir: Go for it. You're in charge!
Ladybug: Take the controls, Cat Noir. I'll be right back
Cat Noir: You'll be right back? Where are you going?!
Ladybug: (goes out of the cockpit) It's just us two now, Gamer!

scene: At a top of a building. Ladybug and Cat Noir land on the building after finishing a battle while the Miraculous Ladybug power is launched.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Wow, you are on fire, bugaboo. We never beat villains so fast. Pound it! (Cat Noir realizes that Ladybug is acting differently) Bugaboo? Something wrong?
Ladybug: (nervously) Uh, pound it - yeah. Hey, why don't we check one more time that everything's okay in Paris? (uses her yo-yo to perch herself to the top of the building) Like, an extra patrol?
Cat Noir: You wanna tell me what's going on? You didn't even scold me when I called you bugaboo
Ladybug: There's nothing going on, everything is super great. I just have some extra time and I really don't feel like chit-chatting
Cat Noir: Then I know the perfect place when there's no talking
Ladybug: I'm all in!

scene: At the cinema.
conversation:
Ladybug: (quietly, but infuriated) You tricked me
Cat Noir: Shh. No talking, you said
Civilian: That's Ladybug and Cat Noir!

scene: At the cinema.
conversation:
Ladybug: (to the movie; furious) Are you kidding me? Don't tell him anything, you fool!
Cat Noir: Could you keep it down, m'lady?
Ladybug: Romantic comedies are lame anyway, and you know why? It's totally not realistic! In real-life, the girl would take forever to tell the guy she loves him without stuttering. Bla-bla-bla! So how can see she know if he loves her back? It's impossible, so then she decides she can never ever be with him, and then BAM! She falls in love with another guy, and everything is so cool. Almost too easy, no stuttering, they hold hands, they get all kissy-kissy, and then, SURPRISE! She has secrets! And him, he hates secrets, of course. So as they break up, and everyone lives un-happily ever after, the end. And that's why romantic comedies are so lame. (Ladybug gets her drink)
Cat Noir: (whispering) So sorry, we'll be going now. (pushes Ladybug as they leave)
Ladybug: Stay AWAY from the romantic comedy, go for heroic heroes instead. Special effects, heroes saving the world, no feelings, no questions, nobody talks because there is NOTHING to say! That is good entertainment for sure
Cat Noir: (laughs nervously) Sorry! (runs quickly to Ladybug)

scene: Outside the theater.
conversation:
Cat Noir: (laughs nervously) Sorry! (runs quickly to Ladybug)
Cat Noir: Listen m'lady, I didn't get everything you said and obviously, I know nothing about your private life, but I do know what heartbreak sounds and feels like, and-
Ladybug: Heartbreak? Me? (laughs nervously) That is not it at all, everything's fine. In fact, I feel like swimming, let's go to the pool! (prepares her yo-yo to transport herself to the swimming pool)

scene: Parisian rooftops.
conversation:
Lady Wifi: She's got to be here somewhere. Let's split up
Cat Noir: Hey there, m'lady. Somebody is having a super villain party and didn't invite us
Ladybug: They're looking for Marinette Dupain-Cheng, one of their classmates
Cat Noir: Haven't we already saved her a bunch of times? Funny you'd think everybody would like her
Ladybug: Well apparently, she's managed to alienate all her friends at once. (struggles to think about the recent event)
Cat Noir: You still there?
Ladybug: Just thinking. With five villians it's not gonna be easy finding the object that has the akuma
Cat Noir: I bet you already have an idea, right?
Ladybug: I'm going to isolate one of the villains from the others and get her to tell me where the akuma is. Meanwhile, you find Timebreaker to stop her from going back in the past, otherwise she could really screw up my plan
Cat Noir: Good luck, M'lady
Ladybug: Thanks, you too
Cat Noir: Hey, it's been awhile. How's it ticking Ms. Time Keeper?

scene: The Canal Saint-Martin.
conversation:
Ladybug and Alya: Pound it
Cat Noir: Ladybug, the Gang of Secrets is looking for you, I'm on it, but I don't know how long I can hold them off all by myself
Shadow Moth: (from his lair) Your friend Lady Wifi has betrayed you, she chose Ladybug's side. Hurry up and seize his Miraculous so you can take care of the bug!

scene: Inside the swimming pool.
conversation:
Rena Rouge: Mirage, Vanish!
Aqua Noir: Cataclysm! (uses to disintegrate the bracelet)
Rose: Thank you, Ladybug

scene: The Trocadéro. While Placide I.T. is still looking for him, he crosses paths with August and his mother.
conversation:
Gigantitan: Lollipop! (He's about to follow the girls when he suddenly hears the sound of a bell, which is shown to be Cat Noir jingling the bell he wears)
Cat Noir: Well, you're the biggest rugrat (I've) ever seen. (leaps up when Gigantitan is about to grab him)
Gigantitan: Kitty!
Cat Noir: Let's go splish-splash, mega-baby. (jumps onto Gigantitan's forehead, and then down to the ground) You can't catch me! (Gigantitan starts to follow him) Let's get our feet nice and wet. But we can't squish anyone, okay?

scene: The Trocadéro. While Placide I.T. is still looking for him, he crosses paths with August and his mother.
conversation:
Ladybug: Hey!
Cat Noir: Over here!
Ladybug: Hey, over here! Big baby!
Cat Noir: This way!
Ladybug: We're losing him, Cat Noir!

scene: Seine. Ladybug is being pulled by Gigantitan.
conversation:
Gigantitan: Lollipop! (He sucks on the fake sign. Disgusted, he throws it away and starts to cry again. He suddenly hears Cat Noir's bell jingling.)
Cat Noir: Who wants a nice tasty lollipop?
Gigantitan: Lollipop! (walks over, pulls up the "lollipop" and peels off the wrapping to reveal Ladybug)

scene: Place des Vosges. Ladybug and Cat Noir continue to battle with Glaciator.
conversation:
Glaciator: Of course, it's always the supervillain's fault. But the mind forgets and the heart remembers! (starts to fire ice creams)
Cat Noir: Maybe he's right, m'lady. After all, he's still André, the Sweethearts' Ice Cream Maker!
Ladybug: (while dodging Glaciator's ice creams) Cat Noir, not now!
Cat Noir: (while spinning his baton) Hey, maybe if we kiss again, our memories would come back!
Ladybug: (annoyed) Ugh, enough! Why don't you take a little cat nap?! (throws Cat Noir into a trash bin, and returns to fight Glaciator, furiously) And as for you, you big two-legged ice cream cone, hand over that akumatized scooper right now!

scene: Place des Vosges. Ladybug and Cat Noir continue to battle with Glaciator.
conversation:
Ladybug: (releases the akuma) I guess ice cream, just like tabloids, can be wrong sometimes
Cat Noir: I guess I'm not your favorite cat at the moment, am I? (walks towards Ladybug) Can I take you to a movie to make up for it? Or how about a restaurant to celebrate our nomination as Couple of the Year?
Ladybug: (yelling) We're not "Couple of the Year", we're not a couple (at all!)
Cat Noir: Sorry! Sorry! I didn't mean to make you so mad. (Ladybug simply looks away from him, still mad.) I get it. You're sick of me. I might sound like a broken record expressing my affection for you over and over. I know I should stop but... I can't help it, you know? I have so many feelings welled up in this heart, and I don't know how to control them
Ladybug: (sighs) I know your heart's in the right place and that you don't mean any harm but—
Cat Noir: (dejectedly) You're right. You shouldn't have to put up with this. I'll stop. I don't know how yet, but I'll figure it out. I promise
Ladybug: (smiles) I'm counting on you
Cat Noir: (frowns) I'll see you later. (vaults away, and Ladybug eventually to the other direction)

scene: The Agreste mansion, in Adrien's room.
conversation:
Cat Noir: (frowns) I'll see you later. (vaults away, and Ladybug eventually to the other direction)
Cat Noir: Claws in…. (de-transforms into Adrien)
Adrien: Ladybug's right, Plagg. I don't have the right to force my feelings on her. This has to change. (I) have to change! (He deletes his photos of Ladybug in his phone and on his computer, although hesitating before doing so.)

scene: On the rooftops. Cat Noir pounces on a roof, ready to destroy all billboards of him and Ladybug kissing.
conversation:
Marinette: That's sweet of you, Tikki! I may be imaginative, but I think I'll need at least a human on this one
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (disintegrates a billboard of him and Ladybug) Claws in! (de-transforms into Adrien)
Plagg: (groans) Have mercy! You know I love cheese, but even I'm starting to get sick of it! (gulps a piece of camembert)

scene: Inside a bus. The two climb aboard. Marinette scans her card, while Cat Noir searches his pocket.
conversation:
Marinette: Is there a problem?
Cat Noir: Well, actually, I always travel by stick, I don't have change for a ticket
Bus driver: This one's on me, Cat Noir! You've saved us so many times, it's the least I can do
Cat Noir: Thanks! I me-owe you one!
Bus driver: You're welcome!

scene: Interior, Cinema. Marinette and Cat Noir sit beside each other.
conversation:
Sharktank: (from the movie screen, v.o) Me too, Mechatiger, but it's impossible! We're sworn enemies!
Cat Noir: But they don't even have mouths! How are they supposed to kiss?
Marinette: Uh, it's been written in advance, so everything's planned out. But in real life, you have no idea how it's gonna go. Just because you tell someone you love them doesn't mean the other will love you back just like that!
Cat Noir: Tell me about it. If only love could be so easy
Marinette: That's why it's so scary to tell someone you love them. Even saving the world seems easy comparing to it. Well, I suppose it is. I mean, just look at you! When you have to save the world with Ladybug, you just bulldoze ahead, you don't think about it! A couple of jokes, and bam! Cataclysm, Lucky Charm, Miraculous Ladybug! And everything's back to normal. Easy as pie
Cat Noir: Yeah, that's the short version, but it sounds about right
Marinette: But telling someone you love them? If it doesn't work out, it's your heart that gets cataclysm-ed, and no Miraculous Ladybug can repair that. That's why I never get anywhere with boys. When things are really important to me, I get so scared that it won't work out that I can't help trying to control every possible outcome! I tell myself stories with wedding dresses, and hamsters, and what people see is not Marinette opening her heart up. It's Marinette talking about some ridiculous nonsense she's made up
Cat Noir: I like hamsters, too

scene: Outside the Cinema. Cat Noir and Marinette walk out as Cat Noir opens an umbrella from his baton.
conversation:
Marinette: You have an umbrella option in your stick?
Cat Noir: Well, yeah! Cats don't like water. (The two of them begin to walk together.) It's funny, you know? I'm kind of the opposite of you. I know that Ladybug is not in love with me, but I can't help telling her how I feel. I wish I could fall in love with someone else, but I can't. She's just so incredible! I'm so afraid I'm not the good person I thought I was, and now I've gone too far, and she hates me
Marinette: (smiles) She doesn't hate you
Cat Noir: She threw me in the trash today
Marinette: You're a good cat. I'm sure you'll figure out what to do

scene: The Dupain-Cheng residence, on the balcony. Marinette and Cat Noir land back safely.
conversation:
Shadow Moth: Akumatization is like ice cream; once you've tasted it, you'll always come back for more! (creates an akuma and releases it) Fly away, my evil akuma, and bring me back two scoops of despair!
Cat Noir: Thanks for flying Cat Noir Airways. We hope you'll be fe-lying again soon
Marinette: (laughs) Thanks! That was nice
Cat Noir: My pleasure

scene: The Dupain-Cheng residence, on the balcony. Marinette and Cat Noir land back safely.
conversation:
Cat Noir: My pleasure
Cat Noir: Oh, wait! Your training!
Marinette: Oh, shoot! I forgot about that!
Cat Noir: Quick! Back into position. You can totally do it this time! I just know it!
Marinette: Dear—

scene: In the Parisian Streets. Glaciator chases after Cat Noir. The villain kicks a car towards Cat Noir's direction and shortly gets blocked by Ladybug. Glaciator continues to fire ice creams at them as the superheroes run to hide.
conversation:
Marinette: Oh, no! I was so annoyed with that whole Couple of the Year thing that I totally forgot to give it to him! Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug and swings out the alley as well)
Cat Noir: Nice to see you again, my... dear friend whom I respect and for whom I have no other feelings than true platonic friendship
Ladybug: Are you making fun of me?
Cat Noir: Not at all! I'm... just getting my bearings
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (uses her power as a car drops in front of them)
Cat Noir: Oh, yeah! That lucky charm really revs my engine!
Ladybug: Okay! Take the wheel. I got a plan

scene: In the Parisian Streets. Glaciator chases after Cat Noir. The villain kicks a car towards Cat Noir's direction and shortly gets blocked by Ladybug. Glaciator continues to fire ice creams at them as the superheroes run to hide.
conversation:
Glaciator: You think you can escape me by attaching me to you?
Cat Noir: Where are we going with this—? I mean, not the two of us. Just... where are we going, like, a direction?
Ladybug: I got it. We're heading to the Gare du Nord. We'll stay in touch. (She continues to drive, escaping Glaciator.) Cat Noir, now!

scene: Parisian streets. Ladybug and Cat Noir are chasing after a runaway bus.
conversation:
Cat Noir: I'm always ready, my lady. Who needs brakes when they've got us?
Cat Noir: So, uh, Ladybug? What would you say if you and I met up tonight for a little dinner? Rooftop style?
Ladybug: For dinner? As superheroes?
Cat Noir: Well, uh, yeah. That's right. We're only together when we're saving Paris. I mean, wouldn't you actually like to get to know one another?
Ladybug: I... That's so thoughtful of you, but I can't. I have to, uh, I already have plans with some friends

scene: Marinette's balcony.
conversation:
Cat Noir: She loves me. (blows out a candle) She loves me not. (blows out a candle) She loves me. (blows out a candle) She loves me
Cat Noir: Hello
Marinette: (gasps) Cat Noir?

scene: Sky above Shanghai. Moonlight.
conversation:
Ladydragon: Don't worry, I found her and brought her to safety during the battle. Ying! ((She turns into an eagle. To Cash)) How about a little trip to the Shanghai courthouse? ((She lifts Cash and carries him away.))
Astro Cat: So we're going home?
Cosmo Bug: Sure, why not? I mean, only if you insist. ((They giggle nervously.))
Astro Cat: Say, which direction do you reckon would be the shortest way to go around the world: 'cross the Arctic or the Antarctic?
Cosmo Bug: Oh, what a fascinating question! And it so happens that I've always wondered myself but never had the chance to find out! ((Giggles nervously.))
Astro Cat: You know what? We should do it right now, and next time we see each other back in Paris, we can check our stopwatches
Cosmo Bug: That's an excellent idea. ((Points backwards.)) I'll go this way
Astro Cat: ((pointing back)) And I'll go that way. See ya soon! Woohoo! ((They fly in opposite directions. Cosmo Bug sighs with relief, lands and de-transforms. She runs off.))

scene: Near Liberty. Flashback to sometime after Migration. Ladybug and Cat Noir watch Luka hug his family from the rooftops.
conversation:
Cat Noir: M'Lady, look. That boy is saying goodbye to his family. He's leaving his entire life behind!
Ladybug: There's no other way, Kitty. Luka Couffaine knows our secret identities
Cat Noir: Are we really sure about that? Has he told you who you are?
Ladybug: (Beat) Yes
Cat Noir: What about me? Did he tell you who I really am?
Ladybug: Of course not! I can never know who you are just like you can never know who I am
Cat Noir: What if he's wrong about me?

scene: Airport. Luka exits a bus and heads towards a plane, while Cat Noir drops down nearby.
conversation:
Cat Noir: What if he's wrong about me?
Cat Noir: Claws in!
Adrien: Hey, wait! Don't go Luka!

scene: Agreste Mansion. Adrien's room. Adrien and Plagg are playing with the foosball table.
conversation:
Adrien: Nathalie! (runs to the bathroom) Nathalie's in danger. Plagg, claws out!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Nathalie: Adrien is still inside!
Cat Noir: I'll take care of him. Get to safety!

scene: Rooftop near Agreste Mansion
conversation:
Cat Noir: You're... (struggling with his heart beating) You're no one's father!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (Destroys the projectile into tiny pieces.) You're just a giant talking statue!
Mister Agreste: Who are you to judge me, you tiny, insignificant creature?!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (destroys Mister Agreste's arm for his parallel guilt from Destruction.) No, no! I'm sorry, I didn't mean to cataclysm you!
Mister Agreste: (regenerates his arm back into place) Did you just try to destroy me, huh?!
Cat Noir: Phew. It really is just a statue. Whoever this akumatized villain is he's hiding inside. Cataclysm!
Mister Agreste: If you want to be spared, help me find the Agreste-son!
Cat Noir: Never! (he lunges at the villain with his Staff but Mister Agreste flicks him across the city.)

scene: Hôtel de Ville. Cat Noir hits the building and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Never! (he lunges at the villain with his Staff but Mister Agreste flicks him across the city.)
Cat Noir: I could really use a helping paw right now, m'lady!
Mister Agreste: No one will stand between me and my son
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (He destroys the piece, but it ends trapping him under a pile of rubble with only his hand sticking out.)

scene: Rooftops of the Jardins du Trocadero. Ladybug and Cat Noir are seen sitting beside each other.
conversation:
Adrien: Pound it!
Cat Noir: Good thing you were there, m'lady. I wasn't at the top of my game today
Ladybug: That's why we're always here for each other, kitty cat
Cat Noir: Claws in. (transforms back into Adrien.)

scene: The streets of Paris and the Parisian rooftops. André Bourgeois and 2 men are turned into raven-pigeon hybrids.
conversation:
Mr. Pigeon: Ladybug, Cat Noir, give yourselves up or else I'll spread my wings even farther. So far, that the entire world will become pigeons! (sends multiple pigeon airplanes)
Rena Rouge & Cat Noir Illusion: If I were you, I'd rather transform people into kittens. Everyone likes kittens better!
Rena Rouge & Ladybug Illusion: Or into Ladybugs. At least they bring good luck!

scene: Rooftops. Ladybug is jumping from roof to roof looking for Mr. Pigeon.
conversation:
Ladybug: Now this is weirder than weird
Cat Noir: (from a ledge above her) Birds of a feather, flock together. (sneezes and falls down to where Ladybug is) I’m allergic to feathers. (sneezes again)
Ladybug: That's helpful
Cat Noir: Tell me about it. (almost sneezes, but stops himself) These birds are only part of the problem. The park keepers in Paris are vanishing without a trace
Ladybug: What? We have to track down Mr. Pigeon ASAP
Cat Noir: Where are we gonna find him?
Ladybug: Hmm, I don't know where we can find him, but I do know where he can find us
Cat Noir: (starts to whistle "La Marseillaise" and then starts to dance)
Ladybug: Act natural or he'll never show up!
Cat Noir: What do you mean? I am acting natural

scene: Place des Vosges. Cat Noir is wearing a park ranger cap and pretending to be a park ranger, while Ladybug hides behind a tree nearby.
conversation:
Ladybug: Call me crazy, but I feel like bird seed all of a sudden. (the pigeons form a shield to keep them in)
Cat Noir: Got any bright ideas, bug?
Ladybug: You're the cat, don't you eat these things for breakfast? (a gigantic cage is brought down over them, imprisoning them) Look!

scene: Place des Vosges. Cat Noir is wearing a park ranger cap and pretending to be a park ranger, while Ladybug hides behind a tree nearby.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Cataclysm!
Cat Noir: Well, well. Looks like the pigeon's really a chicken
Mr. Pigeon: (makes bird noises) Me? I'm not flying away. I'm just killing two birds with one stone. (blows his bird call and jumps over the edge of the roof. Some pigeons catch him, lift him back up and take him away)

scene: Place des Vosges. Cat Noir is wearing a park ranger cap and pretending to be a park ranger, while Ladybug hides behind a tree nearby.
conversation:
Mr. Pigeon: I'm not done with you yet! (makes more bird noises, as his pigeons ride them away)
Cat Noir: I've gotta get out of here before my secret identity's revealed!
Ladybug: Yeah, you wouldn't want to let the cat out of the bag
Cat Noir: Ha ha, very funny

scene: Royal suite. Cat Noir is being taken by Armand.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Uh...? Oh right, no need for litter. But, um, could I have some Camembert? (Mayor Bourgeois looks back at Ladybug. She shrugs)
Cat Noir: 'Scuse me, sorry! (slams the door) It's an emergency! (hears knocking on the door. Cat Noir opens it)
Armand: How do you like your Camembert?
Cat Noir: Runny! (slams the door again. There's another knock and he opens it again. Armand is holding a cloche)
Armand: Unpasteurized Camembert, matured for two years. (hands Cat Noir a cloche)
Cat Noir: Thanks! (slams the door again. His transformation runs out and Cat Noir turns back into Adrien. Plagg spirals out of the ring and lands on the bed)

scene: Hawk Moth's lair
conversation:
Ladybug: Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Yeah! (she throws the bag in the air. Cat Noir throws his staff, which bursts opens the bag)
Ladybug: Snack time, pigeons! (the pigeons go after the popcorn landing on Mr. Pigeon)

scene: Ladybug and Aspik move across the street. Aspik notes some flowers on the ground.
conversation:
Ladybug: (turns)
Aspik: Here. (hands rose) As a thank you for choosing me
Ladybug: Oooh! Uh, thanks. (takes flower and smiles)
Aspik: (smiles)
Ladybug: Eeeeee. (is hit on head by Desperada)

scene: Paris street. The Mime is still driving off in his mimed car.
conversation:
Fred: The Mime. (Zips his lips)
Cat Noir: Argh!
Ladybug: (Swinging over on her yo-yo) Cat got your tongue, kitty?
Cat Noir: Seeing you tends to make me speechless, M'lady

scene: Paris street. The Mime is on top of the building and jumps off holding his hat. He then mimes out a parachute and goes after the cars.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Watch out for unmimed flying objects!
Cat Noir: (Ladybug jumps over and joins him) Seems like he cares a great deal about his hat
Ladybug: The Ultrakuma must be inside

scene: Paris street. The Mime is on top of the building and jumps off holding his hat. He then mimes out a parachute and goes after the cars.
conversation:
Ladybug: There he is!
Cat Noir: Is he mad at black cars or something?
Ladybug: He's probably looking for someone who's inside a similar looking car. Let's sandwich him! (Swings off and kicks The Mime off of his invisible speedboat, making him land at a waterfront deck where Cat Noir is.)(
Cat Noir: So, Mime, who is it you're looking for?
Ladybug: Where'd his hat go!?
Cat Noir: I don't know but I can guarantee he isn't going to tell us where he hid it
Ladybug: (Holding Cat Noir's wrist) Wait, we need a strategy. Without the Mimes hat we can't deakumatize him. (Chibis visualize what the heroes are saying)
Cat Noir: So, we have to make him deakumatize himself
Ladybug: And to do that we need to help him speak his mind to the person he's looking for
Cat Noir: AKA the person who's in one of the black cars. But how can we find the car before The Mime does?
Ladybug: We're going to need some help

scene: TVI tower. TVI studio. A normal-sized Polymouse throws Noé on the studio floor with her Skip Rope.
conversation:
Polymouse: We can begin shooting
Cat Noir: (At the camera) We're rolling!
Noé: The script was telling the truth. You are the villain's accomplices!

scene: We're at the floor of an elevator. Ladybug is on the ground. She opens her eyes, gasps, and looks around. There's drawing in red on the wall of the elevator of a phone and an arrow pointing right towards a turtle. She's holding a tube of lipstick. She and Cat Noir did not know who is attacking them, brainwashing them of losing their memories and making them forgotten.
conversation:
Cat Noir: What happened?
Ladybug: (gets startled and drops the lipstick)—Ah!
Cat Noir: Who are you?
Ladybug: I'm, uh, I—I don't know, (her hand is on her head) I—I don't remember my own name!
Cat Noir: (puts his hand to his head) Me neither. (looking at himself) Looks like you and I were at the same costume party
Ladybug: Hm? Why is that flashing? (her earrings begin to beep)
Cat Noir: And your earrings, too. We must shop at the same jewelry store
Ladybug: Are we supposed to know each other?
Cat Noir: I'd be surprised if we weren't

scene: The roof. Ladybug is running away from Oblivio's blasts. She trips on her yo-yo and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Adrien: Yeah, and you got here just at the right time. (takes his carboard helmet off)
Cat Noir: Hey, pretty cool, right? (Oblivio begins shooting at them)
Ladybug: (they run) Very cool, but try not to lose your memory again!
Cat Noir: Hm, "Stick's features, superpower, Cata—"
Ladybug: Stop! It'll trigger it if you say it out loud
Cat Noir: And it says it can only be used once?
Ladybug: What does your power do, exactly?
Cat Noir: Apparently, I can destroy anything I touch
Ladybug: (smiling) Then stay away from me, if you don't mind
Cat Noir: That's not gonna be easy, Ma— Lady. (she laughs)

scene: The roof. Ladybug is running away from Oblivio's blasts. She trips on her yo-yo and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Ladybug: Cat Noir, now!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (He jumps and touches the blaster. It falls to the ground in pieces and the akuma flies out.)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little Akuma. Time to de-evilize! (catches the Akuma) Gotcha! (releases the white butterfly) Bye, bye, little butterfly
Cat Noir: Wow, so this villain was both these guys? (Ladybug and he look up at the bubble) What do we do about that?
Ladybug: This is where my other power comes in. (picks up the teapot) It fixes everything back to how it was originally. (is about to throw it, but Cat Noir grabs her wrist)
Cat Noir: Wait. Do you think we'll remember all this… afterwards?
Ladybug: Apparently, my Miraculous Ladybug reverts everything, so I'm guessing we won't
Cat Noir: All right then. With your permission, m'Lady…

scene: The roof. Ladybug is running away from Oblivio's blasts. She trips on her yo-yo and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Alya: Uh, Ladybug, Cat Noir?
Cat Noir: Guys, you haven't seen a supervillain named Oblivio, have you?
Nino: You've defeated it already, dude

scene: The roof. Ladybug is running away from Oblivio's blasts. She trips on her yo-yo and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Both: Oh, okay. Pound it? Pound it! (they fist bump)
Cat Noir: We do make a good couple, don't you think? (crosses his arms and leans in) Otherwise we wouldn't have won again like we always do
Ladybug: (with her hand on her forehead) Ugh, we're a (team), not a couple. (enunciating with her hands) Don't start that again! (crosses her arms) I've already told you that I'm in love with another boy. (gesturing towards him) Besides, this charming kitty act of yours was the reason we became distracted (recrosses arms) and got into all this trouble in the first place. (Cat Noir starts to laugh) That's right laugh all you want— (he leans in) Hey, what are you doing?

scene: Parisian streets. Lila is walking home when she sees someone run past her.
conversation:
Oni-Chan: Well this time you're gonna have to give in. Otherwise you'll really get it, whether you want it or not
Cat Noir: Don't you think you should ask the lucky guy what he thinks? (Oni-Chan begins attacking him) Hey, I'm just trying to help
Ladybug: C'mon, this way! (drags Lila to Place des Vosges)

scene: Parisian streets. Lila is walking home when she sees someone run past her.
conversation:
Oni-Chan: (notices Lila running away) It's no use running. Wherever you go, I'll find you
Cat Noir: Not before we capture your akuma anyway
Lila: Please stop! Oh, officer, I'm being followed by a supervillain and Ladybug's failing miserably. You're the only one who can help me! Please protect me!

scene: Place des Vosges. Ladybug and Cat Noir are shocked to see Officer Roger instead of Oni-Chan.
conversation:
Ladybug: Lila?
Cat Noir: Since when does she have a horn? (Ladybug and Cat Noir take off)
Oni-Chan: Go ahead and run. As fast and as far away as you can, Lila Rossi

scene: Officer Roger's car.
conversation:
Sabine: I was in the bakery when this teenager with a horn came running in
Cat Noir: Lila
Ladybug: Oni-Chan must be there already. (to Sabine) Stay here! (she and Cat Noir take off)

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
conversation:
Tom: (taps on Oni-Chan's shoulder, angrily) Ahem. Nobody attacks customers at the Dupain-Cheng bakery. And where is my wife? (Lila runs out and Oni-Chan prepares to follow her) Wait!
Cat Noir: (jumps in front of Lila along with Ladybug) Lila, are you okay?
Lila: You're rushing to my rescue even after all those nasty things I said to you? I really misjudged you, Ladybug! You're the only one who can help me! (hugs Ladybug and her horn grows)
Cat Noir: I knew she'd wind up liking you in the end. (winks)

scene: Parisian streets, next to Collège Françoise Dupont. Oni-Chan is chasing Lila.
conversation:
Lila: And let you get your monster paws on him? No way!
Cat Noir: (hits Oni-Chan with his staff, he is disappointed about being chased around as his true persona) Adrien, Adrien, Adrien. All the girls are fighting over him. No one's fighting over me. Yet I'm so much more sophisti(cat)ed, funnier, and definitely better dressed than him
Oni-Chan: (furiously charges towards Cat Noir) How dare you compare yourself to Adrien, you cursed cat! Adrien is perfection personified! He's the only one who's worthy of me! And the only one I will ever love!
Cat Noir: (shocked) What? (thrown into an )Adrien( billboard, irritated) What are you smiling at?
Oni-Chan: Do you get it now? I'll hunt you down wherever you go. Just give up on Adrien, and I'll stop tracking your every move

scene: Parisian streets. Oni-Chan swaps places with a civilian who Lila runs past and jumps in front of her.
conversation:
Lila: Help, Cat Noir! It hurts so much! I think I might've broken something! (horn grows)
Cat Noir: M'lady, I have an emergency. I won't be long
Ladybug: Are you sure she's not pulling your leg?
Cat Noir: She wouldn't do that now. She really looks like she's in pain. (takes off with Lila)
Ladybug: Then I'm going to need a helping hand here. Lucky Charm! (receives coiled-up plastic tubing, which Oni-Chan snatches)
Cat Noir: Could you take this girl to the nearest hospital, please?

scene: Bus stop. Cat Noir is fighting Oni-Chan when he receives a call from Ladybug.
conversation:
Ladybug: Cat Noir!
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (uses it on the bokken, breaking it and freeing the akuma)
Ladybug: No more evil-doing for you, little akuma! Time to deevilize! (captures akuma) Gotcha! (releases purified butterfly) Bye, bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (Miraculous Ladybug repairs all damage and Oni-Chan turns back into Kagami)
Cat Noir: Kagami. (gives Kagami her rose back)
Ladybug: Pound it!
Cat Noir: I'll take her back home. (carries Kagami) Keep an eye on Lila. She’s as sly as a fox. (takes off)
Ladybug: Your leg looks better

scene: Stage
conversation:
Ladybug: Sorry, Cat Noir, I would've come to get you if I knew your true identity
Cat Noir: Like I always say milady, “to know me is to love me”
Ladybug: On second thought. (laughs quietly) Rena Rouge, Carapace. (they all run to the top of the tower while Cat Noir stays behind) Stay here Cat Noir, I'll be back

scene: Outside the Agreste mansion.
conversation:
Ladybug: Cat Noir, look out! (uses her yo-yo to pull him on top of the statue she's on)
Cat Noir: How'd he know exactly what I was gonna do?
Ladybug: It must be his power. He can anticipate our moves. We're gonna have to figure out how to surprise him. Lucky Charm! (receives a cassette tape) An old cassette? (Party Crasher zaps at the duo, so they jump off the statue. Party Crasher reads Ladybug's movements and absorbs her.)
Cat Noir: NO! (prepares to go towards Party Crasher but is stopped by Master Fu)

scene: Outside the Agreste mansion.
conversation:
Pegasus: Need some back up?
Cat Noir: Pegasus? (sees Viperion) Viperion? (sees Carapace) Carapace? Time to strut your disco stuff!
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Beware of Viperion and his power to go back in time

scene: Outside the Agreste mansion.
conversation:
Ladybug: Cat Noir! (throws the glasses to him)
Cat Noir: Cataclysm! (destroys the glasses and frees the akuma)
Ladybug: (opens yo-yo and throws it at the akuma) Time to de-evilize! (captures akuma) Gotcha! (releases akuma) Bye bye, little butterfly. Miraculous Ladybug! (all damage caused by Party Crasher is fixed)

scene: Stade des Princes
conversation:
Ladybug: (laughs) Nice scare tactics, but it's not gonna work. Cat Noir and I are the best at soccer!
Cat Noir: (Whispers to Ladybug) I don't know a thing about soccer M'lady. Maybe it's time to call the real team?
Ladybug: (Shocked, slowly pushes Cat Noir to guard the goals and heads off) Oh, well Cat Noir will attend the goals while I go get the rest of our team

scene: Stade des Princes. Ivan has received the Ox Miraculous from Ladybug and looks hesitant
conversation:
Penalteam: Blah, blah, blah, blah. Okay, losers, are you done yet?
Cat Noir: (Whispering to Ladybug) You got a plan for getting our paws on the akumatized object?
Ladybug: That'll be our trophy when we win
Cat Noir: What if we don't?
Ladybug: Come on, I know the secrets of this game!

scene: The Champs-Élysées.
conversation:
Ladybug: Thanks for dropping in
Cat Noir: Not very handy, I see
Pixelator: What about our deal?

scene: The Champs-Élysées.
conversation:
Ladybug: Together!
Cat Noir: (in the white space) Ahh! Oh, not again
Pixelator: When the cat's away, the mice will play. Ready to become immortalized?

scene: The Champs-Élysées.
conversation:
Ladybug: Don't do it, Mr. Stone!
Cat Noir: (activates his power up sequence) Cataclysm! (uses his Cataclysm to make a crack in the white space, freeing the people trapped in the photos) Yes!
Pixelator: Come on, open your eyes

scene: TVi Tower. Nadja Chamack and the staff are getting ready and she then eats a chouquette.
conversation:
Nadja: (Nadja sighs after looking around at the empty couch opposite her, where Ladybug and Cat Noir are supposed to be and checks her tablet and then almost drops it out of shock after Cat Noir suddenly appears.) Which way did you come in?
Cat Noir: Secret celebrity door. (Gulps down a drink.) I see Ladybug's running behind, huh?
Nadja: I thought you'd be arriving together
Cat Noir: (Leans close towards Nadja.) Wanna hear a secret? (Nadja nods.) I love chouquettes

scene: TVi Studio. Nadja's show is about to go live.
conversation:
Ladybug: Well, thank you Nadja, we're honored to be here
Cat Noir: And hello to all my fans! (Blow kisses and winks towards the camera and the audience.)
Nadja: I'm sure thousands have tuned in to watch you tonight

scene: TVi Studio. Nadja's show is about to go live.
conversation:
Nadja: People know you but they don't really know you. We see you saving Paris but we don't know anything else about you
Cat Noir: We won't be keeping anything from you, Nadja
Ladybug: Well we do have to keep a few secrets, including our identities of course. (Gabriel smirks.)

scene: TVi Studio. Nadja's show is about to go live.
conversation:
Ladybug: Uh-uh-I'm very sorry Nadja, but we're superheroes. We're not here to answer such personal questions
Cat Noir: Meow, m'ladybug's grown claws
Ladybug: We're here to ensure all Parisians that they're safe and that it's only a matter of time before we defeat Hawk Moth, that's all

scene: TVi Studio. Nadja's show is about to go live.
conversation:
Nadja: Fine. How do you explain these photographs then? (Nadja Chamack uses her tablet and displays a photo of Ladybug and Cat Noir kissing from Dark Cupid which bewilders the superheroes.)
Cat Noir: (Oblivious) What? When did that happen?
Ladybug: (Infuriated) I was saving you, not kissing you!

scene: TVi Studio. Nadja's show is about to go live.
conversation:
Ladybug: These are just a bunch of photos taken out of context! We're only doing our job. We save the city every day, we're not a couple
Cat Noir: But hopefully, one day
Ladybug: (Cat)...not now!

scene: TVi Studio. Nadja's show is about to go live.
conversation:
Ladybug: This interview is so over. (Grabs Cat Noir on the arm, persisting him to leave along with her.)
Cat Noir: Woah, what's the rush?
Ladybug: Uh, there's an alert. Paris needs us right now!
Cat Noir: Uh, sorry. When duty calls... Gotta get going!

scene: TVi Studio. Ladybug and Cat Noir are vaulting through the air until they reach the top of the TVi roof. They then start talking to each other.
conversation:
Nadja: The highest ratings will be mine. (Nadja is transformed into Prime Queen by the Akuma, who now is TV rating controlling supervillain.)
Cat Noir: So who are we saving again?
Ladybug: Just us, Nadja was willing to do anything to make sure her show would be a success and I'm not about to answer anymore of her prime questions
Cat Noir: That's the price of success my lady, the price of stardom
Ladybug: We're superheroes not stars we should be doing our job not looking like fools on TV
Cat Noir: Wait I wasn't planning on getting home so early. Why don't we get some ice cream, I know the purr-fect place

scene: Prime Queen goes through screen on subway and pulls Chloé in with her
conversation:
Chloé: Ladybug, Cat Noir! I beg you, save my jacket!
Cat Noir: (extends his staff through the screen before bringing it back to it's normal size)
Ladybug: What if it's a trap? I think I'd rather get there by my own means
Cat Noir: (in a matter of fact manner) There are many, many subway lines in Paris, which means a hundred and forty miles of rails. If we want to get there in time to save Chloé, I don't think we have a choice
Ladybug: Huh, just admit you love being on TV
Cat Noir: I don't get stage fright, Bugaboo

scene: Subway train that Chloé is held captive in.
conversation:
Cat Noir: I'll deal with the door
Cat Noir: We're trapped!
Prime Queen: The rules for my show are simple, admit the truth live on TV that you're dating and in love and I'll stop the train!

scene: Subway train that Chloé is held captive in.
conversation:
Prime Queen: I want my scoop!
Cat Noir: I'll use my Cataclysm
Ladybug: No wait, we might need it for an emergency
Cat Noir: Yeah, like right now!
Ladybug: We have to lure her over her first or we'll never capture her akuma! So let's just play along with her, at least it'll buy us some time
Cat Noir: Meaning?
Ladybug: (to Prime Queen) Okay Prime Queen (she holds Cat Noir's hand as he looks shocked), you win. I confess, Cat Noir and I (are) dating, like you said. We are..(Close-up of Ladybug's mouth.) in..love
Cat Noir: (purrs)
Ladybug: Did I just hear you purr?
Cat Noir: (nervous) Uh, no way!

scene: Subway train that Chloé is held captive in.
conversation:
Prime Queen: (through screen) Next trial, your Miraculous! Or else your biggest fan will be mummified! (laughs)
Cat Noir: (almost falls through screen as it becomes able to travel through)
Ladybug: Let's leap in, before she runs!

scene: Ladybug and Cat Noir end up landing in a walk in freezer in the kitchen of the restaurant in Le Grand Paris
conversation:
Prime Queen: (laughs through screen)
Cat Noir: Uh, Cataclysm?
Ladybug: (frustrated) There's no point! We're probably far away from the Louvre! By the time we get there it'll be too late to save Alya!
Cat Noir: So, a kiss then? (moves close to Ladybug for a kiss)
Ladybug: (unimpressed) Still not a chance, Cat Noir

scene: Ladybug and Cat Noir end up landing in a walk in freezer in the kitchen of the restaurant in Le Grand Paris
conversation:
Ladybug: You're right! Lucky Charm! (a tape roll appears) A tape roll? What am I supposed to do with this? Hmm... (looks around her as tubs are highlighted) Of course! (Ladybug starts pulling out drawers)
Cat Noir: (anxious) Hurry up, she's about to push Alya in the water!
Ladybug: (still going through tubs) One minute!
Cat Noir: That's (too) long!

scene: Ladybug and Cat Noir end up landing in a walk in freezer in the kitchen of the restaurant in Le Grand Paris
conversation:
Ladybug: Fine, you win, Prime Queen. (behind black screen; Prime Queen listens agitatedly) We'll remove our Miraculous. The whole world will see us without our masks!
Cat Noir: (behind black screen) (And) We're about to kiss! Shame you're missing it!
Ladybug: (So) unlucky!

scene: Ladybug and Cat Noir end up landing in a walk in freezer in the kitchen of the restaurant in Le Grand Paris
conversation:
